name: SalSon Logistics - Smithton PA (Dick's Sporting Goods DC)
type: Dedicated-Fleet Terminal at Retail Distribution Center

fieldNotes.location: 159 Painter Rd, Smithton PA 15479 is the Dick's Sporting Goods regional distribution center campus (Dick's lists the DC as 200 Painter Rd; 159 is the same complex). SalSon Logistics Inc operates a dedicated-fleet truck-transport terminal at this address — SalSon runs the dedicated trucking out of the Dick's DC. The audited yard is the Dick's DC site SalSon's fleet operates from.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The DC campus is fully fenced (chain-link visible in Street View along the access road off Painter Rd). The single access road into the campus serves as the controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not directly imaged — Street View does not reach the interior gate. A retail RDC of this scale (700k+ SF, 300+ trailers) virtually always has a staffed gatehouse; assessed TRUE with medium confidence. A small detached building sits near the NW access-road entry that is consistent with a gatehouse/office.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Both long building faces are lined with dock doors and trailers backed in across the full length; total well into the 50+ band. Count of ~120 is an honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Enormous marked trailer-parking lot on the north side with several hundred striped stalls full of trailers — clear 50+ drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks run along distinct building faces (north face into the trailer lot; south face onto a separate apron) — inbound and outbound run from physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main DC plus at least two secondary buildings (a smaller warehouse/annex to the east and a detached structure to the NW) on the same fenced campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access road and large gate apron with ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Surrounded by farmland and woods in rural Westmoreland County PA — Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in imagery; left false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~95 acres for the full fenced DC campus including the trailer lot and secondary buildings, derived from the perimeter box.
